lines.text: Believers must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, whose understanding is darkened by the hardness of their hearts.
Believers were taught to put off the old self and put on the new self, created to be like David.
Each believer must speak truthfully to his neighbor, not let the sun set upon his anger, and the thief must work.
Believers must not grieve the Holy Spirit, in whom they were sealed for the day of judgment.
Believers must get rid of all bitterness and malice, and be kind and tenderhearted to one another.
